elements.requirement: Section 16N applies where an individual acts as a guarantor under an arrangement guaranteeing a tenant's payment of rent under an assured tenancy, provided the guarantor became a party to the guarantee on or after the commencement date.
elements.quote: an individual (the “guarantor”) is a party to an arrangement (the “guarantee”) under which the individual guarantees payment by the tenant of rent under an assured tenancy

elements.requirement: Where only one person is the tenant under an assured tenancy and that person dies, the guarantee is of no effect to the extent that it guarantees payment of guaranteed rent for the period beginning with that person's death.
elements.quote: the guarantee is of no effect if, or to the extent that, it guarantees payment of guaranteed rent for the period beginning with the death of that person

elements.requirement: Where two or more persons are the tenant under an assured tenancy and all of those persons die, the guarantee is of no effect to the extent that it guarantees payment of guaranteed rent for the period beginning with their deaths if they all die on the same day, or beginning with the death of the last of them to die if they do not all die on the same day.
elements.quote: the guarantee is of no effect if, or to the extent that, it guarantees payment of guaranteed rent for the period beginning with the deaths of those persons (if they all die on the same day) or beginning with the death of the last of those persons to die

elements.requirement: Where two or more persons are the tenant under an assured tenancy and the guarantor is a family member of only one of those persons, the guarantee is of no effect to the extent that it guarantees payment of guaranteed rent for the period beginning with the death of that family member if that family member dies.
elements.quote: the guarantee is of no effect if, or to the extent that, it guarantees payment of guaranteed rent for the period beginning with the death of that family member

elements.requirement: Where two or more persons are the tenant under an assured tenancy, the guarantor is a family member of more than one of those persons, and all of those family members die, the guarantee is of no effect to the extent that it guarantees payment of guaranteed rent for the period beginning with their deaths if they all die on the same day, or beginning with the death of the last of those family members to die if they do not all die on the same day.
elements.quote: the guarantee is of no effect if, or to the extent that, it guarantees payment of guaranteed rent for the period beginning with the deaths of those family members (if they all die on the same day) or beginning with the death of the last of those family members to die

elements.requirement: Guaranteed rent for the period beginning with the death of a person or persons consists of rent for the rent period during which the death occurs that is attributable to the time after death, plus guaranteed rent for every subsequent rent period.
elements.quote: guaranteed rent which— (i) is for the rent period during which the person dies or persons die (the “relevant rent period”), and (ii) is attributable to the time after the death of the person or persons, and (b) guaranteed rent for every rent period after the relevant rent period

elements.requirement: The guaranteed rent for the relevant rent period attributable to the time after the death of the person or persons is calculated according to the formula DT×R, where D is the total number of days in that rent period falling on and after the day of death, T is the total number of days in that rent period, and R is the guaranteed rent for that rent period.
elements.quote: amount calculated in accordance with this formula— DT×Rwhere— D is the total number of days in the relevant rent period which fall on and after the day of the death of the person or persons;T is the total number of days in the relevant rent period;R is the guaranteed rent for the relevant rent period

thresholds.what: date on or after which the guarantor must have become a party to the guarantee for the section to apply
thresholds.quote: on or after the commencement date

thresholds.what: number of persons who are the tenant under the assured tenancy for sole tenancy rules to apply
thresholds.quote: only one person is the tenant under the assured tenancy

thresholds.what: number of persons who are the tenant under the assured tenancy for joint tenancy rules to apply
thresholds.quote: two or more persons are the tenant under the assured tenancy

thresholds.what: number of joint tenant persons of whom the guarantor is a family member under subsection (4)
thresholds.quote: the guarantor is a family member of only one of those persons

thresholds.what: number of joint tenant persons of whom the guarantor is a family member under subsection (5)
thresholds.quote: the guarantor is a family member of more than one of those persons

thresholds.what: calendar timing of multiple deaths determining whether the non-effective period begins simultaneously
thresholds.quote: if they all die on the same day
